name: Runner Extras - List Of Codeunit State
brief: Proves List of [Codeunit] element access works on the skeleton runtime, including across procedure scopes.
description: Reproduces the Pageworks 212-test cluster: SharedNavObjectList<NavCodeunitHandle>.Get threw on the skeleton because Company.SharedObjects is null on the lazy-create path. A stateful codeunit is Added to a List of [Codeunit] in a CALLEE scope and retrieved via Get in the caller; its instance state must round-trip. Also covers the same-scope Add+Get discriminator.
